item.title: Life: A Game of Games
item.author: long.thoughts.blog@googlemail.com (Felix)
item.description: Living in a complex world, everyday we’re moving between friend groups, work, chores, dreams and drama. Each and every area of life has such depths, that it seems like a world in of itself. A game of games, which follows certain rules.
